versions.changelog:
- Updated version to 1.0.9.
- Added note advising to install, update, and verify OpenClaw only via official documentation and not to pin or copy OpenClaw versions from this skill.

atlas-avatar 1.0.8

- Added a setup script (setup-realtime-viewer.sh) to automatically clone, configure, and update the reference atlas-realtime-example viewer app.
- Updated documentation to describe the new viewer setup script and clarify usage steps for launching the browser UI with required environment variables.
- Declared bash as a required binary in skill metadata.
- Clarified regression harness invocation and browser viewer setup in the configuration section.

atlas-avatar 1.0.7

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md to clarify intended usage with the official reference viewer app ([atlas-realtime-example](https://github.com/NorthModelLabs/atlas-realtime-example)).
- Added explicit overview and instructions for matching agent usage to the recommended browser app architecture.
- Clarified environment variable naming differences (ATLAS_API_BASE vs ATLAS_API_URL) when using this skill alongside the example app.
- Streamlined viewer guidance and usage notes for agents and users.
- No code changes—documentation update only.

atlas-avatar 1.0.6

- Clarified that cloning the full monorepo is not required for most agent users; only needed for advanced scripts or local tools.
- Added a dedicated "Viewer" section explaining how to use browser-based or hosted viewers to see and hear avatars, without needing to clone code.
- Updated guidance and table for different use cases: full UI, hosted demos, agent scripting, and minimal future options.
- Improved documentation on agent and end-user setup, reducing onboarding friction for basic use.

atlas-avatar 1.0.5

- Updated documentation to clarify **passthrough** realtime session mode (you bring your own STT/LLM/TTS, Atlas handles only GPU lip-sync and streaming).
- CLI commands streamlined: only passthrough/conversation mode supported for new sessions; removed old `--mode` argument.
- Updated `SKILL.md` and API references for improved clarity and accuracy.
- Minor code and doc cleanups for consistency.

atlas-avatar 1.0.4

- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md with comprehensive usage examples, including CLI, environment setup, and Discord integration.
- Clarified configuration details and provided environment variable defaults.
- Added instructions for both realtime (LiveKit) and offline (Atlas API) avatar generation flows.
- Documented scripts and workflows for posting offline avatar videos to Discord.
- Included fallback `curl` usage examples for API access without Python dependencies.
